arithmetic.label: Arithmetic
arithmetic.summary: Core arithmetic topics: the largest share of Tier 1 and Tier 2 Quant.

number-system.label: Number system
number-system.summary: Divisibility, remainders, unit digit, factors, number of zeros.

simplification.label: Simplification & BODMAS
simplification.summary: BODMAS, approximation, fractions and decimals, square and cube roots.

hcf-lcm.label: HCF & LCM
hcf-lcm.summary: HCF, LCM, their product rule, and word problems on both.

percentage.label: Percentage
percentage.summary: Percentage change, successive change, population and consumption.

ratio-proportion.label: Ratio & proportion
ratio-proportion.summary: Ratio, proportion, variation, and dividing a quantity in a ratio.

average.label: Average
average.summary: Average of groups, change in average, weighted average.

profit-loss.label: Profit, loss & discount
profit-loss.summary: Profit and loss, marked price, successive discount, false weights.

si-ci.label: Simple & compound interest
si-ci.summary: SI, CI, difference between CI and SI, instalments.

time-work.label: Time & work
time-work.summary: Work efficiency, alternate days, wages, pipes and cisterns.

tsd.label: Time, speed & distance
tsd.summary: Average speed, relative speed, trains, boats and streams, races.

mixture-alligation.label: Mixture & alligation
mixture-alligation.summary: Alligation rule, replacement of mixture, mean price.

partnership.label: Partnership
partnership.summary: Profit sharing by investment and time.

ages.label: Ages
ages.summary: Age problems based on ratios and sums.

algebra.label: Algebra
algebra.summary: Identities, equations, inequalities, surds and indices.

algebraic-identities.label: Algebraic identities
algebraic-identities.summary: Square and cube identities, x + 1/x type problems.

linear-equations.label: Linear equations
linear-equations.summary: Pairs of linear equations and their conditions.

quadratic-equations.label: Quadratic equations
quadratic-equations.summary: Roots, sum and product of roots, nature of roots.

surds-indices.label: Surds & indices
surds-indices.summary: Laws of indices, rationalising, comparing surds.

inequalities.label: Inequalities & maxima/minima
inequalities.summary: Basic inequalities and finding least or greatest values.

geometry.label: Geometry
geometry.summary: Lines, triangles, circles and polygons: heavy in Tier 1 and Tier 2.

triangles.label: Triangles
triangles.summary: Congruence, similarity, centres of a triangle, theorems.

circles.label: Circles
circles.summary: Chords, tangents, angle properties, common tangents.

polygons.label: Quadrilaterals & polygons
polygons.summary: Properties of quadrilaterals and regular polygons.

mensuration.label: Mensuration
mensuration.summary: Areas, perimeters, surface areas and volumes.

mensuration-2d.label: Mensuration 2D
mensuration-2d.summary: Area and perimeter of triangles, quadrilaterals and circles.

mensuration-3d.label: Mensuration 3D
mensuration-3d.summary: Cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, sphere, frustum.

trigonometry.label: Trigonometry
trigonometry.summary: Ratios, identities and heights and distances.

data-interpretation.label: Data interpretation
data-interpretation.summary: Tables, bar graphs, line graphs, pie charts.

statistics.label: Statistics
statistics.summary: Mean, median, mode, and Tier 2 statistics topics.

c-ai-cubes.label: Cubes of big numbers
c-ai-cubes.summary: Add and subtract cubes of two-digit numbers without a calculator: last digit first, then a rough size.

c-ai-reciprocal.label: x + 1/x and its powers
c-ai-reciprocal.summary: One value of x + 1/x unlocks x² + 1/x² and x³ + 1/x³ through two small identities.

q-ai-cubes.label: Sum and difference of big cubes
q-ai-cubes.summary: Cubes of numbers like 32, 19 and 38 added, subtracted and adjusted.

q-ai-reciprocal.label: Value of x + 1/x
q-ai-reciprocal.summary: x is given (often a surd); find x + 1/x or a power of it.

c-av-total.label: Average is total ÷ count: work with totals
c-av-total.summary: Turn every average into a total (average × count). Missing parts are then plain subtraction.

c-av-weighted.label: Weighted average
c-av-weighted.summary: Groups of different sizes: weigh each group's average by its size.

c-av-spaced.label: Evenly spaced numbers
c-av-spaced.summary: For numbers in steps (multiples of 13, odd numbers…) the average is the middle: (first + last) ÷ 2.

q-av-parts.label: Find a missing number or a group's average
q-av-parts.summary: Overall average, some group averages known; find the number or the average that is left.

q-av-weighted.label: Average of groups in a ratio
q-av-weighted.summary: Group averages and a ratio of group sizes; find the overall average.

q-av-spaced.label: Average of multiples between two numbers
q-av-spaced.summary: All integers between two limits that are divisible by k.

c-di-sets.label: Reading a two-set table
c-di-sets.summary: Who knows A, who knows B, who knows both. 'Only' groups and the 'both' group must be added back before comparing.

q-di-overlap.label: Totals from 'only' and 'both' groups
q-di-overlap.summary: A table gives 'A only', 'B only', 'both' and 'neither'; find a total for one skill or a ratio of totals.

c-hl-rem.label: Remainder problems: the LCM sets the period
c-hl-rem.summary: Numbers that leave the same pattern of remainders repeat every LCM of the divisors, so find one such number and add multiples of the LCM.

q-hl-lcm-offset.label: Divisor minus remainder is the same every time
q-hl-lcm-offset.summary: Each remainder is the same amount short of (or over) its divisor, so N = LCM × k ∓ that amount.

q-hl-two-rem.label: Different remainders for different divisors
q-hl-two-rem.summary: Find the first number that fits both remainders, then step by the LCM; count or find the largest.

c-le-point.label: A point lies on a line when it satisfies the equation
c-le-point.summary: Put the point's x and y into the equation. If both sides agree, the point is on the line.

q-le-point.label: Substitute a point into a line
q-le-point.summary: Find an unknown in the equation, or pick the option point that lies on the line.

c-m2-circle.label: Circle: area, circumference and what scales
c-m2-circle.summary: Area grows as the square of the radius, circumference as the radius. Compare shapes before computing.

c-m2-ring.label: Rings and pathways (annulus)
c-m2-ring.summary: A ring is the outer circle minus the inner: π(R² − r²) = π(R − r)(R + r).

c-m2-sector.label: Sectors, arcs and central angles
c-m2-sector.summary: A sector is a fraction θ/360° of a circle; arc = rθ when θ is in radians.

q-m2-part.short: Part or ratio of a circle
q-m2-part.label: Part of a circle, or area ratio of similar circles
q-m2-part.summary: A fraction of a garden is cultivated; the ratio of areas of two circles; the part of a circumference in a turn.

q-m2-compare.label: Same wire: circle against square
q-m2-compare.summary: The same perimeter makes a circle or a square; compare the areas.

q-m2-ring.label: Area of a ring or a path around a circle
q-m2-ring.summary: Outer and inner radius given; area of the ring, or its ratio to the whole.

q-m2-sector.label: Sector angle, arc length and area
q-m2-sector.summary: Arc and radius give the angle; two sectors of one circle are compared.

c-m3-solids.label: Cone, prism and sphere: the formulas that matter
c-m3-solids.summary: A handful of formulas cover the exam: cone slant height, prism volume, sphere and cylinder volumes.

c-m3-displace.label: Immersed solid: volume in = volume of water raised
c-m3-displace.summary: A solid dropped into a vessel raises the water by exactly its own volume.

q-m3-cone.label: Slant height, radius or height of a cone
q-m3-cone.summary: Two of radius, height and slant height are known; find the third (Pythagoras).

q-m3-prism.label: Prism or cuboid volume after a change
q-m3-prism.summary: Base area and height give the volume; a height change scales it.

q-m3-displace.label: Sphere dropped into a cylinder of water
q-m3-displace.summary: Sphere volume equals cylinder volume of the water rise; solve for the radius.

c-mx-ratio.label: Mixtures of one liquid in another
c-mx-ratio.summary: Keep track of the part that does not change (the juice, or the milk-to-water balance) and let the other part move.

c-mx-cost.label: Mixing at different prices
c-mx-cost.summary: The mean price lies between the two prices. Alligation reads the ratio off the gaps to the mean.

q-mx-add.label: Add one liquid to change the ratio
q-mx-add.summary: A mixture in a ratio; add water (or juice) until another ratio is reached.

q-mx-replace.label: Remove some mixture, replace with one liquid
q-mx-replace.summary: Some mixture is taken out and replaced by pure milk; the final ratio is known.

q-mx-profit.label: Profit or loss on a mixed lot
q-mx-profit.summary: Two lots at different costs are combined and sold at one rate.

q-mx-allig.label: Ratio or quantity from a target gain
q-mx-allig.summary: A gain % on the mix fixes the mean cost; find the ratio of the two ingredients or how much of one to add.

c-ns-unit.label: Unit digits and cycles
c-ns-unit.summary: Only the last digit of the base matters, and its powers repeat in a short cycle (length 4 at most).

c-ns-rem.label: Remainders and divisibility
c-ns-rem.summary: Work with the remainder, not the big number: use the divisor's rule, or replace powers by their remainders.

c-ns-factors.label: Prime factorisation: factors, squares, trailing zeros
c-ns-factors.summary: Write the number as a product of prime powers; factor counts, perfect-square divisors and zeros all read off the exponents.

c-ns-count.label: Counting numbers in a range
c-ns-count.summary: Find the first and last member of the list, then (last − first) ÷ step + 1.

c-ns-word.label: Number word problems and digit puzzles
c-ns-word.summary: Translate the words to an equation (or to a product of digits) and solve; many are quicker by trying the options.

c-ns-series.label: Series and sums of numbers
c-ns-series.summary: Pair terms, split into APs, or use the standard sums of 1…n, squares and cubes.

q-ns-unit-pow.label: Unit digit of powers and their products
q-ns-unit-pow.summary: A product or sum of big powers; the unit digit is asked.

q-ns-unit-seq.short: Unit digit of a sum or factorial
q-ns-unit-seq.label: Unit digit of a sum or factorial
q-ns-unit-seq.summary: A sum like 1 + 2 + … + n, or n!, with the unit digit asked.

q-ns-rem-chain.label: Remainders when divided successively
q-ns-rem-chain.summary: A number divided first by one divisor and then its quotient by the next; remainders are given or asked.

q-ns-rem-large.label: Remainder of a very large number or sum of powers
q-ns-rem-large.summary: A long number, a sum of powers or a prime, divided by a small number.

q-ns-nearest.label: Least or nearest number divisible by a given number
q-ns-nearest.summary: Least n-digit number divisible by k, or the multiple of k nearest to a given number.

q-ns-div-rule.label: What must a number or expression be divisible by
q-ns-div-rule.summary: A digit-sum difference, or a sum of two big powers, and the divisors it always has.

q-ns-factors.label: Count factors, square divisors or find the largest prime factor
q-ns-factors.summary: Factorise an expression, then count with (power + 1) or find its biggest prime.

q-ns-zeros.label: Number of zeros at the end of a product
q-ns-zeros.summary: Count the pairs of 2 and 5 in a product of numbers or powers.

q-ns-count.label: How many numbers satisfy a digit or remainder condition
q-ns-count.summary: Numbers ending in a digit, leaving a remainder, or between two roots.

q-ns-word.label: Number word problems (consecutive, sum and difference, primes)
q-ns-word.summary: Consecutive odd numbers, fractions of groups, sum and difference of squares, a rational between two fractions, primes that add up to a total.

q-ns-digit-puzzle.label: Digit puzzles: repeating decimals and digit products
q-ns-digit-puzzle.summary: xy ÷ ab = 0.xyxy…, or digits of a product that follow a rule.

q-ns-series.label: Sum of a series or of the digits of a sum
q-ns-series.summary: Alternating pairs, two interleaved APs, 5 + 55 + 555…, a sum of cubes, a geometric-looking decimal series.

c-capital-time.label: Profit shares follow capital × time
c-capital-time.summary: The one idea behind almost every partnership question.

c-late-entry.label: Late entry and changing capital
c-late-entry.summary: Partners who join late, leave early or change their capital.

c-working-partner.label: Working partner's extra share
c-working-partner.summary: A commission or salary comes off the top before the ratio split.

c-common-unit.label: Rent shared by animals: one common unit
c-common-unit.summary: Pasture and rent questions are partnership with animals instead of money.

q-pt-two.label: Two partners: share or total profit
q-pt-two.summary: Capitals and times given; find a share, or find the total profit from a share.

q-pt-late.label: Partners join at different times
q-pt-late.summary: Two or three partners; some join after some months.

q-pt-working.label: One partner works for extra %
q-pt-working.summary: A working partner takes a % of profit first, then shares the rest.

q-pt-pasture.label: Pasture / rent with animal equivalence
q-pt-pasture.summary: Different animals for different months; convert to one animal, then split rent.

c-pc-of.label: Percent of a quantity, in money and distance
c-pc-of.summary: A percent is a fraction of 100. Turn each percent into a small fraction first and the arithmetic usually cancels.

c-pc-change.label: Percentage change
c-pc-change.summary: A change of x% is a multiplier of (1 + x/100). Chain multipliers; weight them by size when parts differ.

q-pc-calc.label: Sum of percentages of quantities
q-pc-calc.summary: Several percents of several amounts, added; or commissions on items sold.

q-pc-money.label: Percent in a money story
q-pc-money.summary: A return, a price rise or a running cost; find the monthly rent or the extra expenditure.

q-pc-area.label: Percentage change of an area
q-pc-area.summary: A length changes by x%; the area changes by (1 + x)² − 1.

q-pc-mix.label: Overall change when parts change differently
q-pc-mix.summary: Spending in a ratio; each part rises or falls by its own %; find the overall change.

c-pg-angles.label: Angle sum of a polygon
c-pg-angles.summary: The angles of a quadrilateral add to 360°. In a cyclic quadrilateral opposite angles add to 180°.

q-pg-ratio.label: Angles in a given ratio
q-pg-ratio.summary: Four angles in a ratio like 1 : 3 : 4 : 4; find the largest or smallest.

c-pl-multiplier.label: Everything is a multiplier
c-pl-multiplier.summary: A profit, a loss, a markup and a discount are all just numbers you multiply the cost by.

c-pl-quantity.label: Quantity changes: false weight and free units
c-pl-quantity.summary: The seller changes how much you get, not what you pay.

c-pl-rate.label: Rates (n for ₹x) and mixing
c-pl-rate.summary: Buying and selling rates given as 'n for ₹x', or goods mixed before selling.

c-pl-symmetry.label: Equal profit and equal loss
c-pl-symmetry.summary: When two selling prices give the same profit and loss, the cost sits exactly between them.

q-pl-chain.label: Markup, discount and profit chain
q-pl-chain.summary: Marked price above cost, one or more discounts, then profit % or cost price.

q-pl-weight.label: Dishonest dealer: false weight
q-pl-weight.summary: A weight lighter than claimed, often with a markup or a discount on top.

q-pl-free.label: Free units, donation and overall gain
q-pl-free.summary: Buy n get f free, units given away, then the overall profit or loss.

q-pl-rate.label: Rates 'n for ₹x' and mixed goods
q-pl-rate.summary: Costs and selling price given as 'n for ₹x'; mix several kinds before selling.

q-pl-equal.label: Same profit and loss at two prices
q-pl-equal.summary: Profit at one price equals loss at another; find cost, or the result at a third price.

c-rp-change.label: Ratios after something is added
c-rp-change.summary: Write the old quantities as ratio × k (the unknown multiplier), apply the change, and match the new ratio.

c-rp-equal.label: Several quantities tied by percentages
c-rp-equal.summary: 40% of P = 0.5 of Q = 1/8 of R: set them all equal to one number k and read off the ratio.

q-rp-add.label: Ratio changes after adding
q-rp-add.summary: Quantities in a ratio; some are added and the ratio changes; find a number added or the original total.

q-rp-swap.label: Numbers and prices swapped
q-rp-swap.summary: A price ratio and a bill that changes by a % when the quantities are interchanged.

q-rp-chain.label: P : Q : R from percentage links
q-rp-chain.summary: Percentages or fractions of three quantities are equal; find their ratio.

c-ci-growth.label: Compound interest is repeated multiplication
c-ci-growth.summary: Each year the amount is multiplied by the same factor (1 + r/100). So times and powers move together.

c-si-line.label: Simple interest is a straight line
c-si-line.summary: Interest = P × r × t ÷ 100. With several loans at one rate, add P × t for each and divide once.

q-ci-multiple.label: How long to grow k times?
q-ci-multiple.summary: It triples in 6 years; how long to become 27 times?

q-ci-find.label: Principal or rate from two amounts
q-ci-find.summary: A sum becomes A₁ after n years and A₂ after n + 1 years; find the rate or the principal.

q-ci-fractional.label: Compound interest for years and months
q-ci-fractional.summary: 2 years 9 months with annual compounding: compound the whole years, simple interest on the rest.

q-si-two.label: Simple interest on two loans at one rate
q-si-two.summary: Two principals for different times, total interest known; find the rate.

c-sm-compare.label: Comparing and ordering fractions
c-sm-compare.summary: Put fractions against a common yardstick (a decimal, or a benchmark like 0.6) instead of finding a common denominator.

c-sm-bodmas.label: BODMAS with nested fractions
c-sm-bodmas.summary: Work from the innermost bracket outwards, keep fractions exact, and estimate first so options can be struck.

q-sm-order.label: Arrange fractions in order
q-sm-order.summary: Four fractions to put in ascending or descending order.

q-sm-bodmas.label: Evaluate nested brackets and mixed numbers
q-sm-bodmas.summary: Brackets inside brackets, mixed numbers and a division; or a very plain sum with decimals.

q-sm-decimal.label: Decimal fractions: cancel before you multiply
q-sm-decimal.summary: Products and quotients of decimals, or a series of decimal fractions that all reduce to the same value.

q-sm-roots.label: Square roots of decimal numbers
q-sm-roots.summary: Sums of √0.49, √59.29 … and statements to be judged true or false.

q-sm-harmonic.label: Series of fractions with a known partial sum
q-sm-harmonic.summary: A series like 5/6 + 5/9 + 5/12 + … written in terms of 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + … = k.

q-sm-root-trick.label: Expression under a root that is a perfect square
q-sm-root-trick.summary: N = a² − a − (a − 1) and √N asked: rewrite as (a − 1)².

c-sd-compare.label: Comparing surd expressions
c-sd-compare.summary: Square both sides (both positive) so the roots shrink, or compare decimals.

c-sd-conjugate.label: Conjugates and rationalising
c-sd-conjugate.summary: (a + √b)(a − √b) = a² − b removes the root. Pairs of conjugates often cancel to a clean number.

q-sd-compare.label: Which surd expression is greater?
q-sd-compare.summary: Sums of square roots on each side; decide <, > or =.

q-sd-rationalise.label: Rationalise and simplify
q-sd-rationalise.summary: Fractions with surds in the denominator, then an expression in x.

c-tw-rate.label: One day's work: rate = 1 ÷ days
c-tw-rate.summary: Convert every time to a work rate and add rates when people work together.

c-tw-lcm.label: Total work as the LCM: units of work
c-tw-lcm.summary: Pick the total work as the LCM of the times; every rate becomes a whole number.

c-tw-pattern.label: People joining on a pattern or leaving midway
c-tw-pattern.summary: Work out one full cycle, count whole cycles, then finish the remainder.

q-tw-together.label: Working together for some time: fraction left
q-tw-together.summary: Add the rates, multiply by the time, subtract from 1.

q-tw-efficiency.label: Efficiency ratio against days
q-tw-efficiency.summary: Efficiency is inversely proportional to days; swap the ratio.

q-tw-leave.label: One worker or pump stops partway
q-tw-leave.summary: Work done by all, then the remainder done by the rest. Pipes and cisterns are the same.

q-tw-cycle.label: Workers join in a repeating pattern
q-tw-cycle.summary: One cycle's work, whole cycles, then a part-day.

c-tr-angles.label: Radians and degrees
c-tr-angles.summary: π radians = 180°. Convert by replacing π with 180.

c-tr-ratios.label: Ratios of an acute angle
c-tr-ratios.summary: From one ratio get the other five with a right triangle; complementary angles swap sin and cos.

q-tr-convert.label: Convert radians to degrees
q-tr-convert.summary: An angle like 3π/2 radians in degrees.

q-tr-complement.label: sin(90° − B) = cos B
q-tr-complement.summary: A ratio of (90° − B) is given; find the cofunction of B.

q-tr-triangle.label: Another ratio from one ratio
q-tr-triangle.summary: cos A = 5/13 (A acute); find tan A.

c-sd-basic.label: Speed, distance and time: units first
c-sd-basic.summary: One formula and one habit: write minutes and hours in the same unit before dividing.

c-sd-relative.label: Relative speed: meeting and chasing
c-sd-relative.summary: Towards each other speeds add; in the same direction they subtract.

c-sd-circular.label: Overtaking on a track
c-sd-circular.summary: The faster one overtakes after closing the gap between them at the relative speed.

q-sd-convert.label: Same distance, different time or route
q-sd-convert.summary: Distance changes by a percentage, time is fixed, find the new speed.

q-sd-units.label: A rate in short time scaled to a long time
q-sd-units.summary: Distance in 1 minute; find the distance in hours.

q-sd-meet.label: Two bodies meet: opposite or same direction
q-sd-meet.summary: Two meeting times give two equations: sum and difference of speeds.

q-sd-overtake.label: First overtake on a circular track
q-sd-overtake.summary: Gap ÷ relative speed gives the time; times the faster speed gives the distance.
